text: On screen, paper cards reconnect. The spring paper proposes a bounce, but its strength is not unique. The sharp corner paper replaces that engine with an incompatible inserted turn. The mass-mapped paper passes starting size and heat, not rotation. The collapsed paper offers a lone, unsupported line, not a bridge. Helium hears no whisper. Even the loudest stack remains about 10,000 to 100,000 times below the floor. A stadium-buried whisper. The strongest root ends at a ceiling. The ceiling says the root stays closed.
